source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
This unit gains the following when it is **selected to shoot** in your Shooting phase using **[close-quarters shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting)**:

- Its attacks against a unit **engaged** with it may ignore modifiers to **BS** and to **Hit rolls**.
- You may remove **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** from any of its **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapons. Such a weapon can then target only an enemy unit that no other friendly unit is engaged with.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
